name: Brenebase (this hub)
what: Andrew's main entry point outside the Claude app: routes thoughts to tools and modes, splits jobs (code to Claude Code, art and story elsewhere) and merges them, keeps project cards that update themselves, collects update files from Claude sessions, and starts the PC models remotely over Tailscale.
where: https://brenebase.fly.dev (deploy: Actions > Brenebase Deploy, run by hand)
stack: PC worker and PC agent (Node) on Andrew's PC

tools.name: Send
tools.what: Go: a model plans the parts (PC model for private work), Run sends them; project pills pick the project

tools.name: Images tab
tools.what: Z-Image Turbo, Illustrious XL and the manga LoRA, run by the Brenebase worker on the PC with stable-diffusion.cpp (F:\AI\minimax-h3\sd-cli\sd-cli.exe, models in F:\AI\image-models)
tools.use_when: any picture; Brenai Studio is not needed

tools.name: Companion
tools.what: chat on the PC model, full-body doll, look editor, wardrobe, reactions per body part, pictures read by a vision model

tools.name: Doll skill (skills/doll.md)
tools.what: the PC model makes and edits dolls from a description; Doll tool on Send
tools.use_when: changing the companion's look or making a new doll

tools.name: PC tab
tools.what: load the model, start bridges and worker, Update now, find the picture and movie engines

tools.name: Projects tab
tools.what: cards, notes from each project's files, update files

settings.name: Required secrets (names only)
settings.note: everything else is optional and turns one part on

settings.name: Optional
settings.value: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, MESHY_API_KEY, GITHUB_TOKEN, TS_AUTHKEY, PC_TAILNET_HOST, COPILOT_TOKEN, HUB_WORK_LOCAL, HUB_UPDATE_DIRS

settings.name: PC worker paths (optional env on the PC)
settings.note: defaults: F:\AI\minimax-h3\sd-cli\sd-cli.exe, F:\AI\image-models, the first LM Studio model of type vlm

working: Update files from repos, PC folders, direct posts and its own jobs
PC agent by Tailscale or polling, jumpstart
open: Fold the mocap page and clip converter in for both rigs
MiniMax-H3 movies still go through Brenai Studio: read the engine's options (PC tab), then run it in the worker
Picture reading needs a vision model in LM Studio (or Claude chosen in the companion settings)
rules: Deploys and Meshy spends always wait for Andrew's OK
Work context never goes to Claude
